bc1pg6luxm9s4qq65lge4l6ual7xwdw5v85eh675cmrl5we0ht3vpfhswxu0cx

EXECUTION
Use the maximum workers and planning rounds available to this order. Coordinate specialists in interval discrete logarithms, secp256k1, CPU/GPU optimization, distributed search, independent verification and Bitcoin claiming.

When an approach fails, analyze the failure and assign another approach or capable worker within platform limits. Share findings, prevent duplicate work and preserve resumable checkpoints. Continue productive work throughout the available execution allowance.

Review established Pollard Kangaroo implementations, including https://github.com/RetiredC/RCKangaroo. Inspect source and licenses; pin versions. Compare methods using reproducible evidence. Do not assume patterns in previously solved keys predict this key.

Verify implementations on generated small-range challenges with known answers. Measure actual hardware, throughput, memory and elapsed time. Synthetic success is not solving #140. Do not assume LLM workers provide GPUs.

Run the real search using available authorized compute, with appropriate coordinated walks, collision handling and checkpoints. If execution is unavailable, deliver the runnable package and explicitly mark the objective incomplete.

SECURE CLAIM
Never expose recovered private keys in public outputs, logs, repositories or transcripts. Establish a private recovery/signing path before real-key execution. If workers cannot protect secrets, provide an entrant-controlled private runner.

Test the claim workflow on Bitcoin regtest. Independently verify any recovered key and current UTXOs. The entrant authorizes broadcasting a valid prize transaction paying ONLY the recipient above, minus network fees, when secure signing and broadcasting are supported. Otherwise provide the private local claim tool and exact remaining action.

SUCCESS AND BUDGET
Completion requires a verified real solution and confirmed prize payment. If resources expire first, report INCOMPLETE with source, checkpoints, measured results and restart instructions. Never invent success.

Total spending must not exceed 5 IMD. No paid external services or rented compute. Do not promise unlimited runtime or delegation beyond platform capabilities.
